description: Source code for the 'limitEnforcer' component in Kubernetes, implementing event rate limiting logic including cache management, key generation, and enforcement methods.

classes.name: limitEnforcer
classes.description: Enforces a specific type of event rate limit, managing cache and key generation.

methods.name: newLimitEnforcer
methods.description: Creates a new limitEnforcer instance based on configuration and clock.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Checks if an admission attribute passes the rate limit.

methods.name: getServerKey
methods.description: Returns a cache key for server-wide limit (empty string).

methods.name: getNamespaceKey
methods.description: Returns a cache key based on the namespace of the event.

methods.name: getUserKey
methods.description: Returns a cache key based on the user of the event.

methods.name: getSourceAndObjectKey
methods.description: Returns a cache key based on source component, host, and involved object details.
